source: Christopher Booker, The Seven Basic Plots (2004)

tier_note: High-level plot-genre enum. Use only the seven category names (facts/ideas); descriptions are authored for monomyth.

items.name: Overcoming the Monster
items.description: The hero confronts and defeats a great evil or threatening force menacing their world.

items.name: Rags to Riches
items.description: An ordinary or overlooked figure rises to greatness, loses it, and regains it transformed.

items.name: The Quest
items.description: The hero and companions journey toward a distant goal, overcoming trials along the way.

items.name: Voyage and Return
items.description: The hero travels into a strange world, survives its dangers, and returns changed.

items.name: Comedy
items.description: Confusion and misunderstanding escalate, then resolve into clarity, union, and reconciliation.

items.name: Tragedy
items.description: A flawed protagonist's fatal course leads inexorably to downfall and ruin.

items.name: Rebirth
items.description: A dark force falls over the protagonist until a redemptive act brings renewal and light.
